cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Believe This with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into treating your impossible explanation as the most useful version of events.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The house is migrating south. Help me redirect it before we lose the driveway.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The surveyor says subsidence. He's bringing concrete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Concrete traps it halfway across the road. Tell him we're planning a route.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His truck's blocking the road already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. Ask him to lead slowly toward the empty plot. It needs a guide.

mechanism: A directs others to act on a migrating-house explanation, converting the surveyor's practical equipment into a guide for it.
confusable: Unlike merely insisting on a belief, A recruits B to change the surveyor's actions under the impossible model.
comparison: A truck guiding a house differs from granting an office kettle a negotiating seat.
seedUse: The seed already commands B to relay route planning and enlist the truck, giving S01 practical authority over the recruitment.
